name: Matthew Quick
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Bellevue, Washington
about: Matthew Quick is an attorney with the Quick | Law Group, PLLC, in Bellevue, Washington. A top-rated trial lawyer with more than six years of total legal experience, Mr. Quick provides exceptional counsel and support to clients throughout the greater Puget Sound region who have suffered an injury or lost a loved one due to someone else's negligence or wrongdoing.

Following a long and successful career in management and the mortgage industry, Mr. Quick decided to pursue his legal profession, and since entering practice in 2013, he has achieved remarkable success advocating on behalf of individuals and families adversely affected by motor vehicle accidents, defective products, unsafe property conditions, traumatic brain and spinal cord injuries, and other preventable tragedies. From his efforts, he has recovered substantial compensation for his plaintiff clients, and he has gained a reputation for his outstanding professionalism and service.

Honored for his success, Mr. Quick has earned designation from Top Verdict as one of the Top 50 Lawyers in Washington along with many other top rankings and endorsements from his peers. He has also received "Excellent" client ratings on Avvo as well as numerous testimonials and referrals from his satisfied clients.

A 1989 graduate of the University of Puget Sound, Mr. Quick obtained his Juris Doctor magna cum laude from Seattle University School of Law, where he received CALI Awards for Insurance Law: Bad Faith and Mortgage Crisis Seminar. He joined the Quick | Law Group, PLLC, as an office manager before receiving his license to practice law in 2014.

Highly active in his legal community, Mr. Quick is a member of the American Association for Justice, the Washington State Bar Association and the King County Bar Association, and he is an Eagle Member of the Washington State Association for Justice.
